name: workday-soap-fault
description: A SOAP fault from Workday makes wd-connector:invoke throw; with no exception strategy the listener answers 500.

source.reference: adding-a-new-customer-to-workday-revenue-management/src/main/app/add_a_new_customer.xml (flow add-customer-flow: http:listener path=/ allowedMethods=POST, xml-to-dom, dw 'XML to Workday PutCustomerRequest XML', wd-connector:invoke type=Revenue_Management||Put_Customer, dw 'Extract Customer Name' Put_Customer_Response.Customer_Reference.@Descriptor, set-payload 'Added customer: #[payload]') (no exception strategy -> default)
